name: Ferret Frenzy — Full Dossier Pass + Bots v3
notes: Frontend-only full dossier alignment pass. The tested Google Apps Script backend remains authoritative and unchanged. Live players and guest bots receive randomly dealt roles from game.state; the frontend does not reserve roles. The pass aligns cards, sleep/HUD, GeoJSON crime-scene interaction, dice, card movement, teamwork/private facts, Paw Point voting, Solo + Bots, and embedded How to Play guides.

backend.note: Existing tested Google Apps Script backend is referenced only. No .gs backend file is included, generated, or modified.

botEngine.mode: frontend guest bots for browser-owned autofill seats
botEngine.roleSource: authoritative game.state startingRole after backend deal
botEngine.seatFill: When Fill Empty Seats is enabled, Bots v3 guest seats fill empty target seats before game.start; each bot loads its role-specific brain only after the backend deal returns startingRole.

nightLock.display: black viewport overlay with frenzy_logo.png; surrounding shell/HUD and live Burrow Clock remain visible
nightLock.chitter: ferret_sound.mp3 layers quietly when sanitized state/events expose Bandit/Raider/accomplice activity; Solo + Bots can also use locally managed bot state already owned by the host controller; no identity is displayed

minnowHitbox.eligiblePlayer: starting BANDIT + isRaider=true + current Night hour is one of that player’s wake hours
minnowHitbox.result: pre-theft scene changes immediately to assets/images/Minnow Treats crime scene-2.png on click
minnowHitbox.sourceOfGeometry: json/minnow-hitbox.geojson fetched at runtime with an approved fallback polygon only if the packaged GeoJSON cannot load.

frontendGameplay.transport: Apps Script POST bodies use text/plain;charset=UTF-8 to avoid JSON preflight failures on GitHub Pages
frontendGameplay.clock: Host client advances tested backend game.advance after each 60-second NIGHT hour; waits and retries while private actions are pending
frontendGameplay.dice: Backend actionPrompt chooses required d6/d12; joystick flick sends game.roll and animates the authoritative returned face
cards: final card reveal for every player
frontendGameplay.nightLock: Sleeping clients see a black viewport + Ferret Frenzy logo while shell/HUD and live countdown remain visible; gameplay controls are inert.
frontendGameplay.chatVoting: Morning Business uses a staged Discuss → Paw Point → Result flow; one shared discussion remains visible through voting; messages have clearer metadata and send guarding; Paw Point retains card-backed private selection plus a final server-authoritative lock.
frontendGameplay.controls: Physical gameplay controls are joystick + /1/ d6 + /2/ d12 + A confirm + B back + X role action. Private Info/Notebook remain HUD tools.
frontendGameplay.preGame: Role deal enters backend PREP, presented as Pre-Game Setup. The actual dealt role card must be acknowledged before the frontend enables the required setup roll/action prompt; Night begins only after backend setup completion.
frontendGameplay.solo: Solo + Bots creates a private target-4 room. On Start, empty seats are created as frontend guest bots; after the tested backend deals roles, each seat loads the matching Ferret Frenzy v3 specialized role brain.
frontendGameplay.botAutofill: No client-side role reservations. Bot guests join and ready before game.start; authoritative startingRole from game.state selects the role brain after the backend deal.

dossierAlignment.deal: Backend-authoritative random deal from an active set with one card per occupied seat plus three Hammock cards.
dossierAlignment.sleep: Black sleep + logo remains inside the game viewport; HUD/Burrow Clock remains visible and active.
dossierAlignment.crimeScene: Clickable hit region is loaded from json/minnow-hitbox.geojson; eligible Raider click changes the local pre-crime scene to the packaged post-crime image while the tested backend remains authoritative.
dossierAlignment.dice: /1/ selects d6, /2/ selects d12, joystick flick commits the required backend roll; animation lands on the authoritative returned face.
dossierAlignment.voting: One Paw Point per active player; simultaneous lock; tied eligible top vote-getters are caught together; Guardian protection and secondary resolution remain backend-authoritative.
help: Full How to Play dialog in lobby
Short Quick How to Play panel/button in the HUD

guides.lobby: Full dossier-oriented How to Play dialog
guides.hud: Short Quick How to Play panel available from HUD and menu
